Exciting fulltime opportunity 
	 Base salary: $88,600 
	 Allowance: $10,000
         Total package: $98,600

Sodexo inspires and nurtures our cooks to become leaders in their industry and deliver fantastic food which delights our customers. All we ask is that you have a passion for what you do, and an eye for innovation. 
If you’re looking to be part of a team driving the latest food trends across Australia, we have several permanent opportunities available for experienced and qualified cooks, working a Fly-In-Fly-Out 2:1 roster, across Australia’s remote sites.  
Who are we looking for?  
If you have a passion for food, thrive in fast-paced environments delivering food to the highest of standards, have strong interpersonal skills and love working alongside a team, we want you!   To be successful, you’ll need: 	 Australian Citizenship or, Full Australian working rights 
Trade Certificate, Certificate III in Commercial Cookery 
Previous experience in mass-catering environments (volume cooking) 
Why choose Sodexo?  
Sodexo is the world’s leading provider of food services. We have a well-respected culinary history – demonstrated by our Love of Food. How do we offer world-class food? We start by attracting top culinary talent. Our cooks are everything to us. We inspire our dedicated team with our global culinary program and culinary academy and ensure they can connect and share best practices. 
We believe the more diverse we are, the stronger we are. No matter your background, we will do all we can to help you thrive. We are committed to promoting equal opportunities, valuing diversity and creating an inclusive working environment for all our employees.  
We offer a competitive salary, many development opportunities and a great recognition program! 
How to apply?  
If you are interested in joining the Sodexo team and you meet the minimum criteria outlined above, please apply with your resume detailing relevant employment experience and availability. 
One of our friendly recruiters will contact shortlisted candidates for a phone interview. This is also your opportunity to ask any questions you may have. 
What are you waiting for? Submit your application today, and become part of the Sodexo family!

result.description:
Experienced Mechanical Fitter wanted for Bowen Basin mine sites. 4/3 roster, $79.50 per hour.   Your new company  Our client is a well-established, family-owned business providing crane maintenance and inspection services across the Bowen Basin mining region. Known for their commitment to safety, quality workmanship and employee development, they have built a strong reputation supporting major mining operations throughout Central Queensland.   Your new role     An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Mechanical Fitter to join a growing team working across various mine sites throughout the Bowen Basin. In this role, you will be responsible for the maintenance, inspection, fault-finding and repair of overhead cranes, jib cranes and associated lifting equipment. You will carry out preventative maintenance, breakdown repairs, component replacements and mechanical inspections to ensure equipment reliability and compliance. Working a 4/3 roster with 12-hour shifts, you will support a range of mining clients while contributing to safe and efficient site operations. This is a long-term opportunity with an ASAP start for the right candidate.     What you'll need to succeed  
 
 Mechanical Fitter Trade Qualification 
 Current Driver's Licence 
 Standard 11 Statement of Attainment 
 Current Coal Board Medical 
 Experience working on overhead and/or jib cranes highly regarded 
 Strong mechanical fault-finding and troubleshooting skills 
 Experience with gearboxes, brakes, bearings and lifting equipment advantageous 
 Commitment to maintaining high safety standards 
 Must be residentially based in Mackay   
 
   What you'll get in return  In return, you will secure long-term and stable employment with a respected family-owned organisation that genuinely values its employees. You will enjoy a competitive flat rate of $79.50 per hour plus superannuation, weekly pay cycles, a supportive team environment and the opportunity to further develop your technical skills and advance your career within the business. With consistent work across multiple Bowen Basin mine sites, this role offers both variety and security.     What you need to do now  If you're interested in this role, applications can be submitted via the "Apply Now" button. Please ensure you are submitting an up-to-date CV. If you have any further questions, please contact Renee Brease on 07 4960 1129.  If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.
